description: Architected end-to-end automated data ingestion and preprocessing pipelines for 58M+ retail records, implementing dynamic column mapping, time-series feature engineering, and robust cleaning workflows that reduced manual data-preparation time by 80%.
Applied LightGBM for large-scale sales forecasting and K-Means/DBSCAN for RFM-based customer segmentation, with emphasis on data quality and reliable analytical workflows.
Built interactive Streamlit/Plotly dashboards for model and pipeline metrics, supporting local model training, automated batch exports, and stakeholder reporting.
Developed a Retail Customer Clustering System processing 500k+ rows, resolving 135k+ missing values/outliers, applying RFM analysis and PCA, and optimizing clustering performance.
Built a Retail Sales Forecasting System using the M5 Walmart dataset, including automated CSV column mapping, time-series feature engineering, and real-time metric visualization.
Designed and deployed a Sentiment Analysis pipeline using Python and NLTK for text ingestion, preprocessing, and multi-class emotion/sentiment classification.
Implemented tokenization, stemming, stop-word removal, and Scikit-learn classifiers for automated text labeling.
Handled the application lifecycle from data collection and preprocessing through model evaluation and deployment.
